what: The official versions of the book Generation Z Developers, oldest first: the versions this repository holds. The working versions live in the public vault and move here when signed off. text_sha256 is the sha256 of the book's frozen markdown as the version was built (the whole book, parts and chapters in reading order, assembled by admin/build/build.py from v1/content/); the build stops when the assembled text no longer matches the newest entry, so the frozen text cannot change without a version. A change to the text is the next minor version; a new edition is the next major. Each version is frozen at v1/versions/<version>.md by the release that made it and never rewritten; the delta between consecutive versions is computed from the frozen files by page_versions.py, block by block and word by word.

versions.where: Amazon paperback (139 pages, published 30 September 2018, ISBN-10 1724194607), Leanpub (60% complete, 136 pages, 30,695 words, last updated 8 October 2018), and DinisCruz/Book_Generation_Z_Developer at 61886444fe5ab118ab18726147826ab05f794edc
versions.by: Dinis Cruz, with content fixes and contributions by Mike Eriksson, Michael Chadwick, Claudio Camerino, Mark Regensberg and Sarah Cruz (the 2018 change log)
versions.why: The first edition as released: imported verbatim from the 2018 repository on 2026-10-18 and frozen. The Leanpub build left the 90 outlines out; this version keeps them, because the second edition starts from them.
